# Lu documentation index

Lu is a job queue for finite coding-agent work against git repositories. The `lu` binary is the
controller and operator CLI; `ting` is the node agent. Start with README.md for the quickstart and
command list.

- [README](README.md): overview, quickstart, commands, limits and docs links.
- [AGENTS](AGENTS.md): build, test, lint and repository conventions for contributors.
- [Security policy](SECURITY.md): private vulnerability reporting and supported versions.
- [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md): released changes.
- [Documentation index](docs/README.md): the docs/ page index.
- [Quickstart](docs/quickstart.md): ten-minute one-machine walkthrough with expected output.
- [Install](docs/install.md): release archives, source builds and service layout.
- [Configuration](docs/config.md): every config table, validation rule and examples.
- [Troubleshooting](docs/troubleshooting.md): quick answers, exact errors and fixes.
- [Worked examples](docs/examples.md): end-to-end task examples.
- [Job lifecycle](docs/lifecycle.md): states, ownership, failure classes and retries.
- [Submitting work](docs/submitting.md): batch submissions and drafts.
- [Dependencies](docs/dependencies.md): chaining, collection and blocked dependents.
- [Publishing](docs/publish.md): publishing a finished diff.
- [Node workspaces](docs/workspaces.md): checkout staging and workspace policies.
- [Dispatch](docs/dispatch.md): labels, taints, providers, exclusions and cordons.
- [Time-aware scheduling](docs/scheduling.md): scheduling windows.
- [Scope](docs/scope.md): harness child-job scope and boundaries.
- [Operations](docs/operations.md): node onboarding, drains, upgrade, rollback, backup and restore.
- [Monitoring](docs/monitoring.md): metrics and node contribution statistics.
- [Security](docs/security.md): controller boundary, limits, audit record and intake signing.
- [Tokens and TLS](docs/tokens-and-tls.md): file rules, rotation and transport security.
- [Compatibility](docs/compatibility.md): wire rules, release compatibility and schema version 8.
- [HTTP API](docs/api.md): routes, request and response shapes.
- [CLI and MCP](docs/cli.md): client guide, `ting` reference and MCP server.
- [Intake](docs/intake.md): signed webhook intake rules.
